test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In July 2021, in which state/Union Territory did the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment of the Government of India launch the ‘Samajik Adhikarita Shivir’ for the distribution of assistive devices and aids to ‘Divyangjan’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Under the ADIP Scheme of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (Government of India), a **"Samajik Adhikarita Shivr**" is to be organised at **FDDI, Imlikheda Chhindwara, Madhya Pradesh on July 31, 2021.** 
 
• Chief Guest of the function Union Social Justice and Empowerment Minister Dr Vi
